notes: P3-OPT-099: MAP-P3 parameter sweep — vary ONLY exit_threshold (= exit_rsi_mid).
Single variable change: exit_threshold 50.0 -> 0.5. All other params identical to baseline.

Mechanic: exit_rsi_mid=0.5 disables the RSI-midpoint exit on the LONG side (rsi>=0.5 is trivially satisfied so the first exit branch never binds) and on the SHORT side the only rsi<=0.5 fires on a near-zero bar (essentially never for an active short).

Hypothesis: degenerate value removes the RSI midpoint exit entirely. If OOS Sharpe is unchanged -> the rsi-mid exit contributes nothing and can be removed. If Sharpe drops materially -> the rsi-mid exit is a real alpha component.
